verdict: Overworld tile-map round fifteen: the Foundry warehouse, McDonnell Douglas Hall and the Central West End row redrawn crisp on Codex tiles inside building outlines (attempts foundry A, slu A, cwe B of three each), the Maplewood parking lot relaid by hand with straight, evenly spaced stall lines (scripts/art/overworld/lot-stripes.py), two small paints; stitched with 0 pixels changed outside the masks, tiles.py check clean, 4x master reinstalled with no stale extraction. Checks pass. Workshop acceptance is Joe's, in art/review.html.

checks.stitch: 4 tiles aligned (drift 8.6, 9.5, 13.5, 0.0), 0 pixels changed outside the masks; tiles.py check: no dead end of 4 px or more
checks.validate: PASS: 96 assets, exact tile coverage at both densities, transparent cut-outs and registered rig frame sizes
checks.suite: art:check, art:test 3/3, svelte-check 0 errors 0 warnings, production build ok, npm test 42 pass 0 fail (1 todo, ticket 25)

limitations: The lot's south edge is mostly hidden behind trees and not parallel to the curb, so the lot's lower part is left as an open aisle rather than a third row of stalls.
The model tiles were redrawn by gpt-image-2 through the Codex CLI; they match the base outside the outlines only to a mean drift of 8.6 to 13.5 levels, which the masks keep out of the master.
